major_cooldowns.name: Thunder Focus Tea
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Hold a Renewing Mist charge for it and empower that cast for the 10 second extension plus the Haste infusion; with Conduit of the Celestials press it on cooldown to keep Heart of the Jade Serpent cycling, and with Master of Harmony keep one of its two charges for a damage window without capping both.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send her out ahead of the damage and chain Enveloping Mists on different injured allies, then follow with Vivify to cash in Invigorating Mists; Gift of the Celestials trades her window down to 12 seconds for a 1 minute cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Chi-Ji, the Red Crane
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Call him when you can stay in melee and press Rising Sun Kick, Blackout Kick and Spinning Crane Kick nonstop, weaving instant Enveloping Mists onto injured allies between them.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 325197 is castable per its tooltip but was not pressed in the sampled parses; all five played Invoke Yu'lon instead.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it into heavy group damage, recast it for Unity Within only when the group is badly hurt and Rushing Wind Kick just went on cooldown, and spend the 8 seconds of Heart of the Jade Serpent that follows on Renewing Mist and Rushing Wind Kick.

major_cooldowns.name: Life Cocoon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Wrap a tank or a dying ally before the hit lands, or use it to solo soak a mechanic; Chrysalis brings it back every 75 seconds.

major_cooldowns.name: Revival
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it as an instant raid-wide save or on a moment that needs a mass dispel, and remember it heals first and dispels second.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Uplifted Spirits cuts this to 150 seconds; 180 is the untalented base from the ability table.

major_cooldowns.name: Restoral
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Take it over Revival when mass dispelling Magic would kill the raid, and use it as the same emergency group heal.

rule.description: Enveloping Mist chains inside Invoke Yu'lon
rule.action: Chain Enveloping Mist onto different injured allies while Yu'lon is out, and save Vivify for once those mists are rolling.

rule.description: Keep Secret Infusion Haste up with Thunder Focus Tea
rule.action: Spend Thunder Focus Tea on a saved Renewing Mist charge so the Haste infusion keeps rolling.

rule.description: Save the Mana Tea channel for banked stacks
rule.action: Bank your stacks and take the Mana Tea channel in downtime before they sit at the cap.
